document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
While  you  watch  from  your  guarded  spot,  you  observe  the 
flicker of Sylvia’s fires. After a moment, they surge into red 
forks of flame.

Guards around the encampment scream an alarm. In seconds 
all  is  pandemonium,  with  smoke  billowing  and  sasquatches 
running  in  every  direction. The  beasts  near  you  succumb  to 
panic, allowing you and Norman to scramble out. Sylvia runs 
to join you.

To sprint for freedom, make a Luck roll: if you succeed, go to 402: if 
you fail, go to 403.
